content: {"rule": "K-G4", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge treats verses cited against a link as unanswered witnesses counting toward breaking it, which is exactly what K-G4 governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "[L1] Matthew 1:18 'before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost' and Matthew 1:25 'knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son' contradict C3's claim of espousal union", "rule_words": "counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.", "room": "'quotes the sentence of the earlier round ... and names that round': whether merely citing the verses against the link suffices, versus requiring both an exact quoted sentence and a named round; I weighed the judge's citation-only treatment against the rule's explicit dual requirement.", "why": "The judge counts Matthew 1:18 and 1:25 as unanswered witnesses against C3's link without quoting any earlier-round sentence that pressed them and without naming any round, so under K-G4 they do not count."}
